# Validation fixtures

`pricing` is an original fictional repository with a deliberate subtraction bug
and a trusted regression test. It is evidence/test data, never imported during
the project's test collection. Acceptance tests copy its frozen files into a
separate retained checkout and apply an explicitly scoped source overlay there.
The fixture tests a simple arithmetic change.

The negative and positive patches, citation checks, authored adversarial answers,
independent review and disagreements are retained separately in ignored local
evaluation storage. The fixture's command is documentation until a registered
acceptance plan actually executes it; an answer review cannot prove it passed.
